title: Jubilant Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful one-pot Norwegian dish featuring unsalted beef stock and a blend of aromatic spices, finished with a cheese-pull and floral notes. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly stew is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, whisk together the unsalted beef stock, dried thyme, and dried rosemary over medium heat.
Add the beef stew meat to the pot, browning on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the pot, cooking until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot, cooking for 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot, cooking for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to low, covering the pot and simmering for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted and well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with edible flowers and serve hot.
